verdict.rationale: The only mobile evidence is an iOS lock-screen widget that starts an audio memo with one tap. That confirms an iOS app with a quick-capture path, but nothing shows it carries the whole knowledge base. The search, linking and backlink docs never say they are available on mobile. missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, evidence that mobile apps support search and linking/backlinks, evidence of feature parity with desktop rather than a companion, independent hands-on mobile reports.
